what_is_closed: the Lowitzer et al. graphite P-V-T publication is recorded as a same-study candidate source
the accessible publisher payload is limited to an abstract and bibliographic record
the candidate cannot be promoted to a source-grade alpha_V/K_T pair without the full payload and uncertainty contract

equation_or_mapping.reported_bulk_modulus_relation: K_T(T,P) = -V*(partial P/partial V)_T; the abstract reports a fitted B parameter but not a row-level K_T/alpha_V pair

major_result.derivation_class: publisher abstract provenance screen; no source-row transcription and no UET derivation
major_result.observable: availability of a same-study graphite P-V-T source for alpha_V/K_T correction inputs
major_result.dependency_unlocked: Candidate-source screening only; no Cp-to-Cv, Ding C_src, alpha_Phi_K, transport, Core, Gravity, or Full Topic 13 dependency unlock
major_result.claim_boundary: This is an abstract-level source screen. It is not a numeric P-V-T package, not a same-state alpha_V/K_T correction, not a Ding TTG material match, and not an external validation.

source.title: Thermoelastic behavior of graphite from in situ high-pressure high-temperature neutron diffraction

reported_scope.measurement_method: in situ neutron powder diffraction on PEARL/HiPr with a heatable Paris-Edinburgh cell
reported_scope.fit_method: Rietveld-refined data fitted with several equations of state

access_boundary: The accessible publisher record establishes the study scope and fitted summary values only.
No machine-readable P-V-T rows, lattice-parameter rows, alpha_V rows, or row-level uncertainty are archived in this package.
The abstract does not establish specimen morphology, isotope/defect state, or equivalence to the Ding TTG specimen.

claim_boundary: The candidate strengthens the source-search boundary only. A permitted full payload with specimen/state identity, numeric rows, units, and uncertainty is still required before the Cp-to-Cv correction route can close.
